messages.Once you select an alternative, you have: Uma ukhetha enye indlela, unewindi elihlukile le-24- amahora ukusuka ekukhetheni kwakho kokuqala ukuze uyishintshe. messages.Our team has confirmed that your refund: Iqembu lethu liqinisekisile ukuthi ukubuyiselwa kwemali sekuphothuliwe. Imininingwane yokubuyiselwa kwemali ingezansi.

messages.Our team will review your choice before: Iqembu lethu lizohlola ukukhetha kwakho ngaphambi kokwenza izinguquko noma ukucubungula noma yikuphi ukubuyiselwa kwemali.

messages.The carrier has marked your package as d: Umthwali usumaki iphakethe lakho njengelifikile. Sicela uthole umzuzu wokutshela ukuthi ulitholile yini.
messages.The credit may appear in your account wi: Isikweletu singavela ku-akhawunti yakho phakathi kwamahora ebhizinisi angu-24–72. Isikhathi sincike ebhange lakho. Uma singakabonakali ngemuva kwalesi sikhathi, phendula kule imeyili futhi iqembu lethu lizokusiza.
messages.There’s a new update on your package. Yo: Kukhona isibuyekezo esisha kuphakethe lakho. Ungathola imininingwane yakamuva ngezansi.

messages.We’re here to help with order queries. R: Sikhona ukukusiza ngemibuzo ye-oda. Ukubuyiselwa, izinxephezelo kanye nezinguquko ziyatholakala ngokuhambisana nezinqubomgomo zesitolo sethu.
messages.We’ve received your order and will begin: Sithole i-oda lakho futhi sizoqala ukulucubungula maduzane. Sikhona ukukusiza noma nini lapho udinga khona.
messages.We’ve successfully sent a refund for you: Siphumelele ukuthumela imali ebuyisiwe ye-oda lakho. Uzothola inani nendawo yokuthola ngezansi.
messages.You can change an alternative for 24 hou: Ungashintsha enye indlela kuze kube amahora angama-24 kusukela ekukhethweni kwakho kokuqala. Uma ususa into, noma yikuphi ukukhokhiswa kuyo kuzobuyiselwa ngemva kokubuyekezwa nokuvunywa kwesicelo sakho ithimba lethu.
messages.You don’t need to take any action. Our t: Awudingi ukwenza lutho. Ithimba lethu lisebenza ukuze i-oda lakho liqale ukuthunyelwa.

messages.Your order has a later expected dispatch: I-oda lakho linezinsuku zokuthunyelwa ezibambezeleke kancane. Sicela usazise uma ufuna ukuqhubeka noma ukhansele.
messages.Your order’s dispatch has hit a hurdle,: Ukuthunyelwa kwe-oda lakho kuhlangabezane nenkinga, futhi ithimba lethu selaziswe. Silindele ukukuthumela phakathi kwamahora angama-24 kuya ku-48.
messages.Your package hasn’t had confirmed moveme: Iphakheji yakho ayikashintshi isimo isikhathi eside. Siyaxolisa ngokungaqiniseki. Ungacela esikhundleni noma ukubuyiselwa ngezansi.
